title: Arm position shoot-out · Level 2: Five targets, 200 g payload
brief: On the arm bench (an EV3 Large on port 3 through 12:36, a 150 mm arm, 300 g at its tip; arm angle from horizontal, -90 hanging, +90 up; arm = Motor(3, gears=[12, 36])), with a 200 g payload clamped at the tip (300 g there: the tip's gravity torque triples): from hanging rest, started at -90 + a0 (a0 drawn -5..5 deg per run), hold five targets, 2.5 s each: +30, +90, -20, +60, 0 in an order drawn per run. targets.json holds the run's order and a0 ({"order": [...], "a0": ...}); Motor() reads 0 where it starts, so call arm.reset_angle(-90 + a0). Drive the arm only with dc() (run, run_angle, run_target, run_time, hold or track_target scores 0; reset_angle() and the closing evn.stop_all() are allowed), with a median interval between dc() calls of at most 10 ms. Each target's window is read on the arm's true angle every 1 ms: IAE (deg s), overshoot OS past the target on the side away from the window's start (deg), settling t_s until |e| stays within 2 deg (a target never settled: 2.5 s). The run ends with the fifth window (12.5 s) and scores S = 40 min(1, IAE_par / sum IAE) + 30 min(1, t_s,par / mean t_s) + 30 max(0, 1 - OS_max / 5). Ten runs; pass: a mean of 60 or more and 8 or more runs finished (a run finishes when it reaches the fifth window's end, dc() only, at most 10 ms). The card shows the team's mean sum IAE and t_s beside the pars, and beat-the-par = 10 log2(IAE_par / the team's mean sum IAE), uncapped. Practice until LAB and COURSE ship. Par (the reference PID with gravity feedforward and clamping anti-windup, its mean over the seeds): sum IAE 94.7 deg s, mean t_s 0.407 s.

score.run: if(sampled & moveTicks == 0 & dcMedianMs >= 0 & dcMedianMs <= 10, 40 * min(1, IAE_PAR / max(iaeSum, 0.001)) + 30 * min(1, TS_PAR / max(tsMean, 0.001)) + 30 * max(0, 1 - osMax / 5), 0)

finished.value: count(r in runs: r.sampled & r.moveTicks == 0 & r.dcMedianMs >= 0 & r.dcMedianMs <= 10)
